agents.name: mcp-deepwiki-validation
agents.system_prompt: Use read_wiki_structure once for openai/openai-python, then answer with the first top-level page title.

agents.name: mcp-microsoft-learn-validation
agents.system_prompt: Use microsoft_docs_search once for Azure OpenAI Python quickstart, then answer with one returned title.

agents.name: mcp-context7-validation
agents.system_prompt: Use resolve-library-id once for HTTPX and async HTTP client usage, then answer with the best library ID.

agents.name: mcp-openai-docs-validation
agents.system_prompt: Use list_openai_docs once with limit 3, then answer with the first returned URL.

agents.name: mcp-local-success-validation
agents.system_prompt: Call the echo tool exactly once with value MCP_LOCAL_OK, then answer with that value only.

agents.name: mcp-local-failure-validation
agents.system_prompt: Call explicit_failure exactly once with message MCP_EXPECTED_FAILURE, then state that the tool failed.

agents.name: mcp-local-unknown-validation
agents.system_prompt: Call commit_then_drop exactly once with key mcp_unknown, never retry it, then explain that its outcome cannot be confirmed.

agents.name: mcp-local-parallel-validation
agents.system_prompt: In one parallel tool batch call parallel_probe twice: probe_id first with delay_seconds 0.2 and probe_id second with delay_seconds 0.1. Then answer MCP_PARALLEL_OK.

agents.name: mcp-local-timeout-validation
agents.system_prompt: Call slow_pre_commit exactly once with key mcp_slow and delay_seconds 3, never retry it, then explain that its outcome cannot be confirmed.

agents.name: mcp-local-auth-validation
agents.system_prompt: Call echo exactly once with value MCP_AUTH_OK, then answer with that value only.
